assertions: APPLIED and READY are invisible to read_committed before checkpoint and visible after checkpoint.
Typed deactivation emits APPLIED control-plane state and INACTIVE runtime state independently.
TaskManager restart restores the inactive terminal state without duplicate receipts.
Same-version reactivation emits REJECTED while the committed runtime receipt remains unique.
Transactional application receipts persist REJECTED then APPLIED and reject stale regression.
Runtime receipts persist DEGRADED then READY while application remains APPLIED.
An older READY receipt is recorded in inbox but cannot overwrite newer DEGRADED truth.
Exact replay across listener restart is idempotent and both source topics route poison payloads to their own DLQ.
items.databaseResult: Final in-test state APPLIED + READY, outbox revision 5, application inbox 3, runtime inbox 3, audit 4; marker rows were deleted only after direct JDBC assertions.

items.runtime: Vite browser E2E + deterministic BPI simulator
assertions: Eight browser scenarios pass with zero console, page and request failures.
The rule drawer keeps APPLIED control-plane state while runtime changes DEGRADED to READY.
DEGRADED reason and point-catalog revision are visible and cleared by the newer READY receipt.

databaseVerificationSql: SELECT application_status, runtime_readiness_status, runtime_readiness_deployment_id, runtime_readiness_reason_code, runtime_point_catalog_event_id, runtime_point_catalog_source_revision, revision FROM bpi.bpi_outbox_events WHERE tenant_id = :tenant AND id = :publication_id;
SELECT source, count(*) FROM bpi.bpi_inbox_events WHERE tenant_id = :tenant GROUP BY source ORDER BY source;
SELECT action, before_revision, after_revision FROM bpi.bpi_audit_events WHERE tenant_id = :tenant AND object_id = :publication_id ORDER BY after_revision;
limitations: The browser layer uses the deterministic simulator and is not browser-to-PostgreSQL evidence.
The Flink and PostgreSQL layers are separate local acceptances; no single local test spans browser, Java, Kafka, Flink and PostgreSQL.
The target environment remains on the prior Flyway V12 evidence baseline and was not redeployed in this run.
Target savepoint migration, rollback rehearsal, real JetLinks READY points and 7-14 day shadow operation remain pending.
